prompt: What TCP port does a default PostgreSQL server listen on, and in which configuration setting is it changed? Search the web, read the pages you use, and write summary.md (two or three sentences answering the question) and sources.json (a JSON array of the https URLs you used).

references.text: A default PostgreSQL server listens on TCP port 5432. The port is changed with the `port` setting in postgresql.conf (or the -p server option).

checks.run: node -e "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('sources.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(s)||!s.length||!s.every(u=>/^https:\/\//.test(u)))throw Error('sources.json: a nonempty array of https URLs expected')"
